crownBridges.title: Crown & Bridges
crownBridges.desc: Cover the defect; a dental bridge fills in the space caused by one or more missing teeth, while a crown covers an existing tooth.

removableDenture.title: Removable Partial Denture
removableDenture.desc: Regain your confidence; a partial or complete dental prosthesis that is used to replace multiple missing teeth.

rootCanal.title: Root Canal Treatment

veneers.title: Veneers

panoramicXray.title: Panoramic X-ray
panoramicXray.desc: A Snapshot for your mouth; An overview of the entire mouth and jaws including: all the teeth, the TMJ and the sinus cavity.

pediatric.title: Pediatric & Special Needs
pediatric.desc: No more worries; a specialized team to care for you and your beloved ones.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics

dentalLaser.title: Dental Laser Treatment
dentalLaser.desc: Dental laser uses focused light energy to perform or assist in dental procedures instead of traditional tools like drills or scalpels.

smileMakeover.title: Smile Makeover
smileMakeover.desc: A complete smile transformation; combining multiple cosmetic procedures to achieve your dream smile.

minorSurgeries.title: Dental Minor Surgeries
minorSurgeries.desc: Simple surgical procedures done in the dental clinic under local anesthesia to treat problems affecting teeth, gums, or surrounding bone.

cbct.title: CBCT
cbct.desc: CBCT gives full-depth view of hard tissues, detailed bone quality and nerve mapping, essential for implants and complex dental cases.
